chunks.subject: AP Chemistry
chunks.title: Q2 — Long Answer (10 points)
chunks.content: AP Chemistry Q2 (Long Answer), 10 points, one point per part. Topic: ascorbic acid — combustion/empirical formula, titration, and kinetics. A(i) [Pt1]: moles of H2O from mass (2.883 g ÷ 18.02 = 0.1600 mol). A(ii) [Pt2]: moles of H (×2 = 0.3200 mol); [Pt3]: empirical formula C3H4O3 from C:H:O mole ratio. B(i) [Pt4]: [HAsc] from titration (0.0160 L × 0.0550 M NaOH ÷ 0.0100 L = 0.0880 M). B(ii) [Pt5]: pKa = pH at the half-equivalence point ≈ 4.1. B(iii) [Pt6]: [Asc−]/[HAsc] via Henderson–Hasselbalch (≈4.0), consistent with B(ii). C(i) [Pt7]: order with respect to HAsc is 1 (rate doubles when [HAsc] doubles at constant [I3−], trials 1 and 3). C(ii) [Pt8]: rate constant k from one trial (≈4.55×10^−4); [Pt9]: correct units M^−1 s^−1. D [Pt10]: I3− has ion–dipole attractions with water while I2 does not. Common failure: reading pKa at the equivalence rather than half-equivalence point; wrong k units; naming dipole–dipole/LDF instead of ion–dipole in D.

chunks.subject: AP Chemistry
chunks.title: Q2 exemplar — Sample 2A, 10/10
chunks.content: Q2 scored 10/10 (all points). Correct moles of H2O, moles of H, and empirical formula C3H4O3 (A); [HAsc] from the titration, pKa at the half-equivalence point, and [Asc−]/[HAsc] via Henderson–Hasselbalch (B); first order in HAsc from trials 1 and 3, correct rate constant, and units M^−1 s^−1 (C); ion–dipole forces between I3− and water (D). Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP Chemistry
chunks.title: Q2 exemplar — Sample 2B, 5/10
chunks.content: Q2 scored 5/10. Earned A(i), A(ii), A(iii) (empirical formula), C(i) (first order), and C(ii) rate constant. Lost B(i) (computed H+ of the NaOH solution rather than [HAsc] from the titration curve), B(ii) (reported pKa at the equivalence point instead of half-equivalence), B(iii) (ratio not determined), the k-units point (wrong units), and D (called the force dipole–dipole rather than ion–dipole). Shows the classic half-equivalence-point misread.

chunks.subject: AP Chemistry
chunks.title: Q2 exemplar — Sample 2C, 2/10
chunks.content: Q2 scored 2/10. Earned only A(i) (moles of H2O) and C(i) (first order in HAsc). Lost A(ii)/A(iii) (no moles of H, wrong empirical formula), B(i) (set up a Kc expression instead of using titration data), B(ii)/B(iii) (no half-equivalence reasoning, no ratio), C(ii) and units (k not calculated), and D (named LDF, shared by both species, plus an incorrect dipole–dipole). Illustrates a low response that banks only the stoichiometry and the reaction-order reading.
